title: 5–6 months of work, as a learning project
author: UserSergeyB
selftext:
The project might appear commercial, but that’s only because I intend to approach development more seriously than one would for typical indie projects.  
  
The core concept isn’t new, but I’ve added my own unique mechanics.

Despite being a simple puzzle game, it features a system for skills and valuable items.

I don’t expect to make much money from this—if I make anything at all. I added monetization primarily to learn how the process works.

The graphics are my own, and the code was written with the help of Codex as a coding partner.

For those who’d like to play: [Gravity Maze](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.curlybrackets.gravitymaze)
